content.text:
**My answer:** I'd pick the second one, because under each name it says in plain Hebrew what is inside, like "מאה עשרים וחמש החברות בעלות השווי הגבוה ביותר בבורסה בתל אביב". In the first one I only get "125-ת"א" or English letters and I'm left guessing. But honestly, son, none of these is for me. It's all shares, and nothing here says how safe it is or compares it to a deposit.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- **The heading.** "קרנות סל" with "4 קרנות". That's funds, and I almost closed it right there. I kept going only because I was asked to.
- **The sentence under the heading.** It says the page shows only some of the company's funds, with the fees from each fund's report. All right.
- **The fund names on the right.** "איי.בי.איי. סל ת"א 125". I don't know who איי.בי.איי. is. It isn't my bank.
- **Screen 1, the "המדד" column.** Only "ת"א-125", "S&P 500" and "MSCI AC World". To me מדד is the price index on the news, so this told me nothing.
- **Screen 2, the "המדד ומה יש בו" column.** The same, plus a sentence about what is inside each fund. I could follow "חמש מאות החברות הגדולות בארצות הברית". The ת"א-90 sentence, "שאינן במדד ת"א-35", runs to three lines and I lost it in the middle.
- **The fees.** I saw "0.35% קבוע" first, and that number stuck with me. Below it are "משתנה" and "נאמן". I don't know what משתנה means here or what נאמן is, and I didn't add them up.

**What I skipped:** the long paper numbers like 1148808, and the "בדף הקרן במאיה" link. I don't know what מאיה is.

**What I didn't understand:**
- (4A) and (4D)
- צובר
- מחזיקה את המניות
- עסקת החלף
- חשיפה לדולר
- מס גם על שינויי המטבע
- נאמן
- משתנה, as a type of fee
- S&P, MSCI AC World
- מאיה

**What bothered me:**
- The black background with grey writing is hard on my eyes. The column headings in particular are pale.
- The bright green-blue on black is hard to read too.
- There are a lot of numbers, three percentages for every fund, and that made me anxious.
- The little labels look like buttons, and I wasn't sure whether I should press them.

It was only two screens, so I didn't get tired. I just felt this isn't my world.
